data.name: Mobile Repair
data.tagline: Pickup, hub repair aur drop — 90 minute mein
data.description: Screen, battery, charging port ya water damage — rider ghar se phone uthata hai, hamare hub par certified technician theek karta hai, aur wahi rider wapas deta hai. Checkup video dekh kar hi aap price approve karte ho.

highlights.title: Pickup & drop FREE
highlights.body: Repair karwane par koi delivery charge nahi

highlights.title: Video quote
highlights.body: Checkup ka video dekho, phir approve karo

highlights.title: Upto 180-day warranty
highlights.body: Har approved bill par digital warranty

highlights.title: Data safe
highlights.body: SIM aur memory card aapke paas hi rehta hai

howItWorks.title: Book karo
howItWorks.body: Model aur problem chuno, 2 minute lagte hain

howItWorks.title: Rider pickup
howItWorks.body: 4 photos aur IMEI ke saath digital receipt

howItWorks.title: Video quote
howItWorks.body: Technician ka checkup video, aap approve karo

howItWorks.title: Wapas ghar
howItWorks.body: Delivery OTP ke saath, warranty card app mein

faqs.question: Repair na karwaun toh kitna lagega?
faqs.answer: Sirf ₹99 visiting/delivery charge. Agar bill estimate se zyada aaya toh cancel bilkul free hai. Phone kabhi hold nahi kiya jaata.

faqs.question: Mera data safe rahega?
faqs.answer: Rider pickup se pehle SIM aur memory card nikalwa deta hai. Phone ka lock aap chahein toh rakh sakte ho, technician sirf hardware test karta hai.

faqs.question: 90 minute ka promise kab lagu hota hai?
faqs.answer: Screen, battery aur charging port jab part stock mein ho. Baaki repairs mein quote ke saath pakka time milta hai.

faqs.question: Payment kab karna hai?
faqs.answer: Delivery ke time UPI, card ya cash se. Approve kiya hua amount hi lagega, ek rupaya zyada nahi.

data.warrantyNote: Original screen par 90 din, premium par 60 aur normal par 30 din. Battery par 180 din tak. Warranty sirf app mein approve aur pay hue bill par milti hai.

data.name: AC Service & Repair
data.tagline: Jet service, gas refill aur repair — ghar par
data.description: Verified AC technician aapke slot par ghar aata hai. Jet pump se deep cleaning, gas top-up, cooling issue ya installation — kaam shuru karne se pehle price app mein dikhta hai.

highlights.title: ₹299 visit adjust
highlights.body: Kaam karwaya toh visit fee bill mein adjust

highlights.title: 30-day warranty
highlights.body: Same problem dobara aaye toh free visit

highlights.title: Jet pump + foam
highlights.body: Indoor aur outdoor dono unit ki safai

highlights.title: Verified experts
highlights.body: Background checked, 5+ saal ka experience

howItWorks.title: Slot chuno
howItWorks.body: Subah 8 se raat 8, aaj ya kal

howItWorks.title: Technician aata hai
howItWorks.body: Start OTP se kaam shuru, live status app mein

howItWorks.title: Price pehle
howItWorks.body: Extra part laga toh pehle app mein approve

howItWorks.title: Warranty lock
howItWorks.body: Bill app mein, 30 din ki service warranty

faqs.question: Visit fee kab lagti hai?
faqs.answer: Visit ₹299 hai jo kaam karwane par bill mein adjust ho jaati hai. Sirf checkup karwa ke repair mana kiya toh ₹299 lagta hai.

faqs.question: Gas refill ka price fixed kyun nahi?
faqs.answer: Gas ki quantity leak aur AC tonnage par depend karti hai. Technician pressure check karke app mein exact quote bhejta hai, aap approve karo tabhi refill hota hai.

faqs.question: Kitne AC ek visit mein ho sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Jitne chahiye. Booking mein AC ki quantity chuno, har AC ka price alag dikhega.

faqs.question: Cancel karna ho toh?
faqs.answer: Technician assign hone se pehle bilkul free. Assign hone ke baad ₹49.

data.warrantyNote: Service aur repair par 30 din, compressor par 180 din tak. Warranty sirf app ke bill par.

data.name: Bike Repair & SOS
data.tagline: Mechanic 15-20 min mein, jahan aap ho
data.description: Raaste mein bike band ho gayi, puncture ho gaya, ya ghar par service chahiye — nearest verified mechanic GPS se aap tak aata hai. Part chahiye toh runner le aata hai, bada kaam ho toh garage tak tochan.

highlights.title: Visit ₹149 = pehla kaam
highlights.body: Visit fee mein ₹149 tak ka kaam included

highlights.title: Part runner se
highlights.body: Mechanic wahin rukta hai, part 10 min mein

highlights.title: Garage tochan
highlights.body: Bada kaam ho toh safe tow, aapki approval se

highlights.title: 15-day warranty
highlights.body: Same problem par free re-visit

howItWorks.title: Location confirm
howItWorks.body: GPS se 2 tap mein, landmark optional

howItWorks.title: Mechanic aata hai
howItWorks.body: Live ETA, masked call, Start OTP

howItWorks.title: Pay in app
howItWorks.body: Bill app mein toh warranty bhi pakki

faqs.question: Raat ko bhi mechanic milega?
faqs.answer: Haan, 24x7. Raat 10 se subah 6 tak visit fee ₹249 hoti hai, bulane se pehle dikhti hai.

faqs.question: Bill kaise banta hai?
faqs.answer: Bill = max(visit fee, labour) + parts. Jaise tubeless puncture ka labour ₹120 hai toh bill ₹149 (visit included).

faqs.question: Part nahi hua mechanic ke paas toh?
faqs.answer: Runner part le aata hai. ₹300 tak ka part auto, usse upar app mein aapka approval leke hi kharida jaata hai.

faqs.question: Bike on-spot theek nahi hui toh?
faqs.answer: Mechanic garage tochan suggest karega with rough quote. Aap approve karo toh safe tow, warna sirf visit fee.

data.warrantyNote: Chain, clutch aur cable adjust par 15 din, puncture par 7 din (same spot), brake pads par 30 din.

data.name: Fridge Repair
data.tagline: Cooling, gas aur compressor — jald aa raha hai
data.description: Single door, double door aur side-by-side fridge ke liye verified technicians. Cooling issue, gas leak, thermostat, compressor — sab ghar par, price pehle.

highlights.body: Repair karwane par bill mein adjust

highlights.title: Compressor warranty
highlights.body: 180 din tak, supplier-backed

highlights.title: Gas leak test

highlights.title: Same-day slot
highlights.body: Subah 8 se raat 8
